row.evidence: G2's plan comparison ticks "SSO: Provision my.G2 admin access using your identity and access management (IAM) platform" only on Professional and Enterprise (both Contact sales); G2's SSO docs add that "SCIM provisioning enables you to add, update, and remove my.G2 users directly from Okta."
row.notes: Scored as a provisioning target for my.G2, the vendor-side admin portal. SCIM is part of G2's SSO setup (SAML app plus G2-provided SCIM Base URL and bearer token), which the plan comparison ticks only on Professional and Enterprise, both Contact sales; G2 also says to contact your G2 representative to turn SSO on. Starter is $299/mo or $2,999/year for year 1 (year 2 $599/mo or $6,000/year), flat with unlimited users, so per-user fields are null. Setup steps exist for Okta only, as a custom SAML app (not an OIN listing); the docs say other IAM platforms that support SCIM can update the same attributes. G2 is not listed in the Okta OIN, Entra gallery, Google SAML catalogue or JumpCloud's list. The G2 API covers product, review and buyer-intent data, not user admin. Note: every first-party G2 domain (sell.g2.com, documentation.g2.com, data.g2.com) is on validate.py's third-party ban list for g2.com.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Flat price, unlimited users; for companies with 1-100 employees.

auth.token_source: my.G2 > Single Sign On > Single Sign On (Details section: SCIM Base URL and SCIM Authentication Token)

deprovision.data_retained: The user's personal G2 account remains; SSO grants that account permission to manage your products in my.G2.
deprovision.notes: Docs say SCIM can remove my.G2 users; seats are unlimited on every plan, so seat freeing does not apply.

custom.how: first_name, last_name and company must be mapped as SAML attribute statements for SCIM updates to apply

attributes.notes: Group attribute names inferred from Okta Push Groups; G2 does not publish a SCIM schema.

roles.how: Group-based: each my.G2 group carries one role; Okta groups can be pushed or linked to my.G2 groups. New SSO users default to the Marketing group.

limitations.text: Setup steps are documented for Okta only (custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM enabled); other IdPs are described generically.
SSO, and with it SCIM, must be configured by a G2 representative first; users also need a personal G2 account to reach my.G2.
Users cannot sign in to my.G2 until they are assigned the app in Okta.

scim.notes: No SCIM version, base URL pattern or endpoint list is published; the base URL is shown per organization in my.G2.

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per second per source IP (Cloudflare).

user_api.notes: The G2 Seller API (OpenAPI v2) covers products, reviews, buyer intent, reports and the current user (/api/v2/users/me/products); no endpoints manage my.G2 admin users or groups.

okta.notes: Not in the OIN (search for G2 returns only Okta Org2Org); G2 documents a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM provisioning in Okta.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (g2-tutorial returns 404).

google.notes: Not in Google's pre-integrated SAML catalogue.

jumpcloud.notes: Not in JumpCloud's SSO application guide list.

fallbacks.notes: Without SSO, users join via an invite URL tied to a group.
